business_summary: Changshu Fengfan Power Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the production of angle steel tower, steel pipe composite tower, pipes, transformer substation structure support, steel pipe pole, and various steel structure parts for transmission lines in China. The company is involved in the production and sale of cold-formed steel, square and rectangular steel pipes, and steel structural parts; the sale of lubricating oil, diesel oil, fuel oil, asphalt, and chemical products; asset and investment management; overseas and domestic bidding projects; and the import and export of goods and technology. It also provides metal materials, metal products, mechanical equipment, coal, electronics, hardware, and related products; towers and communication and transmission infrastructure; development, sale, and marketing of power equipment and materials; transmission and substation-related services; survey and technical consulting services for energy projects; photovoltaic power generation equipment leasing; manufacturing and sales of photovoltaic equipment and components; solar power generation technology services; energy storage technology services; energy technology research and development; foreign contracting projects; machinery and equipment leasing; centralized fast charging stations; charging pile sales; and related technical services. In addition, the company offers technical consultation, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion; engineering management services; the sale of industrial control computers and systems; gold and silver products; sale of special electronic materials and communication equipment; integrated circuit chip design and related services; research and development of special electronic materials; integrated circuit design; and information technology consulting services. Changshu Fengfan Power Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Changshu, China.
